# Keeping the manifest fresh with a prek hook

<!-- generated by `cargo xtask build-skill-refs`; do not edit by hand -->

Extracted from `docs/third-party.md` (section `prek-hook`).

Add this to `.pre-commit-config.yaml` in your plugin's repo to
prevent committing a stale manifest:

```yaml
- repo: local
  hooks:
    - id: toolr-manifest
      name: toolr manifest in sync
      language: system
      entry: toolr self build-manifest my_pkg --check
      pass_filenames: false
      files: ^src/my_pkg/.*\.py$
```

Replace `my_pkg` and the `files` pattern to match your package.
